name: @immunity-wars/server
description: The relay (Phase 3): the hub, platform-free, and a Node adapter on ws for the development machine.
comment:why-ws-is-pinned: The first dependency of a process that LISTENS (docs/SECURITY_NOTES.md). Pinned exactly so that an upgrade is a decision with an audit beside it, never a side effect of an install. No dependencies of its own.
comment:why-session-is-a-dev-dependency: Only relay.test.ts imports it: the integration test plays RelaySession against this relay and holds it against LocalSession. The relay itself never runs client code.
